answer: PJP1 can be read as file-backed byte tensors without CPU unpacking when the consumer accepts bitpacked uint8 hypervectors. A QNN/HTP consumer will likely require one explicit staging copy into an accelerator-compatible buffer unless it can import file-backed memory.
arrow_ring_sidecar_reason: No equivalence-promoted sidecar is needed for byte-tensor staging; Arrow/ring remains optional if future consumers require columnar IPC.
